Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

DIMENSIONS OF SPINDLES AND MOUNTING ARRANGEMENTS 
FOR SPINDLE OPERATED ELECTRONIC COMPONENTS 

PART 1 SPINDLES 
Section 6 Coupling Spindle 

( Second Revision ) 



0. General — This standard (Part 1/Sec 6) shall be read in conjunction with IS: 4586 ( Part1/Sec 1 )- 
1987 'Dimensions of spindles and mounting arrangements for spindle operated electronic com- 
ponents: Part 1 Spindles, Section 1 General and definitions ( second revision )'. 

1. Scope — Covers dimensions of coupling spindles. 

2. Dimensions — See Table 1. 



Adopted 30 November 1987

Gr 1 



BUREAU OF INDIAN STANDARDS 
MANAK BHAVAN, 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR MARG

Note 1 — If intermediate values are required, they should preferably be chosen from R20 series (mm) [(See 
IS : 1076-1967 'Preferred numbers ) ( first revision )]'. 

Note 2 — The tolerance on the length may be ± 2 mm for potentiometers with high rated dissipation. 

Note 3 — Chamfer at 40°/50° or a radius for a depth of between 5 percent and 10 percent of dimension A. 

Note 4— The underlined dimensions are preferred diameters. [(See IS: 1076-1967 Preferred numbers) (first 
revision )]. 

Note 5 — Values for dimension B are chosen from R20 series ( mm ). 

Note 6 — Fixing of bush may be done by pressing a 'C washer in the groove cut in the shaft to a depth of 
1 to 1'5 mm. 

Note 7 — Dimensions apply to spindles after suitable finish.
